progettazione.descrizione: An exceptionally energetic, charismatic and captivating native American English male storyteller with a clear General American accent. Vocal energy of a passionate science communicator with the confident resonance of a mature presenter. Fast-paced but perfectly articulate, highly expressive, warm, magnetic and full of genuine curiosity. Lively pitch variations, punchy emphasis, natural conversational style for educational YouTube narration. Never elderly-sounding, sleepy, flat, breathy, robotic or overly formal; no artificial hype or shouting.
